plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cisco Small Business switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, temperature, fan, power supply status, and interface traffic, for Cisco Business CBS, SG300/SG500 and Catalyst 1200/1300 series (enterprise PEN 9, CISCOSB subtree). Memory is not reported.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the 1-minute average CPU utilization of the Cisco Small Business switch (rlCpuUtilDuringLastMinute, a scalar GET with instance .0), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. The value 101 means CPU measurement is disabled and is dropped at collection time. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, broadcast storms, or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature of each stack unit of the Cisco Small Business switch in degrees Celsius (rlEnvFanDataTemp). High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or airflow obstruction and risk thermal shutdown.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the fan state of the Cisco Small Business switch (rlEnvMonFanState), normalized so that 1 = healthy (normal / not present) and 2 = fault (warning / critical / shutdown / not functioning). A value greater than 1 indicates a fan failure that can lead to overheating.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the power supply state of the Cisco Small Business switch (rlEnvMonSupplyState), normalized so that 1 = healthy (normal / not present) and 2 = fault (warning / critical / shutdown / not functioning). A value greater than 1 indicates a power supply problem or lost redundancy.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
